author: Top Gear
description:
This is the new Mercedes-AMG CLE 646 Spezialanfertigung. Which is a rubbish name and someone in Mercedes’ marketing department should be fired, because this is really a new Mercedes-AMG Black Series model. It’s based on the CLE Coupe, and features a 646hp V8 driving the rear wheels, a unique widebody, a big weight saving and wild aero. Think of it as Mercedes-AMG’s rival for the Ford Mustang GTD!
